  • Method Details

    • parse

      @Nullable public static @Nullable EntityType parse(String string)
      Parses the provided string into a EntityData and stores in a new EntityType.

      The string allows formats of "number + entity" and "article + entity", but never "article + number + entity" or "number + article + entity". Allowed: - 1 zombie, 3 pigs, 5 endermen - a zombie, a pig, an endermen Not-Allowed: - a 1 zombie, a 3 pigs, an 5 endermen - 1 a zombie, 3 a pigs, 5 an endermen

      Parameters:
      string - The String to parse.
      Returns:
      EntityType containing the parsed EntityData and provided amount if present in string or -1 if not present. Otherwise null if the parse failed.
